description: A client workspace's monthly report: what reached them, what was kept out, the worst catches (redacted), per form. Returns the numbers and the shareable url (a page the client can open or print to PDF).

api_key.description: Doorman API key (dm_live_...). Only needed if the MCP connection has no Authorization header.

month.description: YYYY-MM, or 'current' for this month so far. Default: last month.

name: doorman_client_report
